commands: RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUNID"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/$RUNID; gh pr diff 1438 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/$RUNID/diff.patch | head -5; echo "---DIFFSTAT---"; gh pr diff 1438 --name-only

for f in skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md skills/pr-description/SKILL.md; do echo -n "$f "; sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1; done

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cp -r skills "$TMP/"
cp .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/run1/diff.patch "$TMP/d.patch"
cd "$TMP"
# apply only the skill hunks; use git apply with --include
git apply --include='skills/*' --directory=. d.patch 2>&1 | head
sha256sum skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md skills/pr-description/SKILL.md

TMP=$(mktemp -d); cp -r skills "$TMP/skills"; git apply --include="skills/*" --directory="$TMP" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/run1/diff.patch; sha256sum "$TMP"/skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md

TMP=$(mktemp -d); cp -r skills "$TMP/skills"; git apply --include="skills/*" --directory="$TMP" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/run1/diff.patch; sha256sum "$TMP"/skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/rev && cat > .prflow/tmp/rev/h.sh <<'EOF'
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cp -r skills "$TMP/skills"
git apply --include="skills/*" --directory="$TMP" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/run1/diff.patch
sha256sum "$TMP"/skills/docs-release-notes/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-external/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/docs-sync-internal/SKILL.md "$TMP"/skills/pr-description/SKILL.md
EOF
bash .prflow/tmp/rev/h.sh
rm -rf /tmp/rev1438 && mkdir -p /tmp/rev1438 && cp -r skills /tmp/rev1438/skills && git apply --directory=/tmp/rev1438 -p1 .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1438/run1/diff.patch

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
